title: RabbitMQ Outbox Practice in C23
practicalRequirements: Start with the invented data and trace the steps on paper. Optional compiler, SDK and adapter steps are for your own practice environment. The C state model has no broker, SDK, or network dependency. The practical discussion assumes AMQP 0-9-1.
